title: Redstrike Engagement Reasoning-Provenance Trace
description: Persisted, entity-keyed lineage of HOW findings came to be (runtime/reasoning_trace.json): a graph of reasoning steps — goal (objective) -> intent (hypothesis) -> fact (evidence) -> finding — where every node has a stable id and each finding node CROSS-REFERENCES an existing finding id (finding_id) so a consumer can link the trace to the finding it explains. Unlike the ephemeral free-text run stream, this is durable and keyed to stable entities, so it can drive the console's exploration-graph provenance overlay. Strictly additive + crash-safe: an absent/partial trace never breaks a run or the graph. Produced by cli/redstrike_cli/reasoning_trace.py after the post-run gate.

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the last write (the trace is re-derived in full each run).

id.description: stable node id (e.g. goal:root, intent:<category>, fact:<finding_id>, finding:<finding_id>).

kind.description: goal=objective; intent=hypothesis; fact=evidence; finding=a produced finding.

parent.description: the upstream node id this derives from (null for the root goal).

finding_id.description: the EXISTING finding id this node cross-references (fact + finding nodes).

category.description: the coverage category id the intent/fact belongs to.

producer.description: the executor skill slug behind this step.

evidence_ref.description: a path to the evidence artifact backing a fact.

rel.description: spawns=goal->intent; yields=intent->fact; proves=fact->finding; derived_from=fact->intent (a prior fact motivated a deeper hypothesis).
